nodes.rationale: Entries stamped with the extraction-spec prompt file so a prompt change re-extracts instead of replaying stale results (#1939).

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time, so --falkordb-push is preferred over the cypher.txt artifact.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only above 5000 words; small corpora value structural clarity, not token compression.

nodes.label: Step 6 HTML / Obsidian Export
nodes.rationale: Obsidian is opt-in because it generates one file per node.

nodes.label: Corpus Size Warning (>2M words / >500 files)
nodes.rationale: Large corpora prompt the user to narrow to a subfolder; --no-cluster suggested when no subfolders exist.

nodes.label: Python Interpreter Detection (.graphify_python)
nodes.rationale: Handles uv tool, pipx, venv and system installs; persisted so every later step uses the same interpreter.

nodes.label: Step 9 Manifest and Cost Tracker
nodes.rationale: Only stamp semantic files that actually produced output so a failed chunk is re-queued on the next --update (#2015).

nodes.label: Scan Root (.graphify_root)
nodes.rationale: Scan path passed through a quoted heredoc rather than the command line so a malicious path cannot execute as shell code.

nodes.label: --cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Self-contained; Steps 5-9 must not rerun because their intermediates were deleted (#1392).

nodes.label: Step 4.5 Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: Read-only diagnostic surfacing dangling/missing endpoints, self-loops and collapsed edges from incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches.

nodes.label: source_file Verbatim Rule
nodes.rationale: Keeps full build and --update on the same base so replace-on-re-extract matches existing nodes.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Every re-extracted source_file is dropped from the base before merge so stale nodes do not survive (#1344); preserves edge direction (#801).

nodes.label: Shrink Guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to overwrite graph.json with a smaller graph so an empty or partial extraction never clobbers a good graph.

nodes.label: Part A Structural (AST) Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and free; code needs no LLM or API key.

nodes.label: --watch Folder Watcher
nodes.rationale: Debounce (3s) waits for file activity to stop so a wave of parallel agent writes triggers one rebuild; code changes rebuild without LLM.

nodes.label: prune_sources (Deleted Files)
nodes.rationale: Only for deleted files; adding changed files would delete re-extracted content.

nodes.label: Monorepo Per-Subfolder Extract
nodes.rationale: CLI places graphify-out inside each scanned path, avoiding clobbering a shared output dir.

nodes.label: Fast Path: Existing Graph
nodes.rationale: When graph.json exists and the request is a natural-language question, skip rebuild steps and query the graph directly - the graph is already built.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Query CLI uses substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms; expanding only from graph vocabulary prevents zero-hit noise without inventing tokens.

nodes.label: create-next-app Boilerplate Assets
nodes.rationale: Default static icons scaffolded by create-next-app; no references found in src, so likely leftover starter files.

nodes.label: Domain Hint Whisper Prompt
nodes.rationale: The host LLM writes a one-sentence domain hint from god node labels, avoiding a separate API call.
